_comment: Official sources the pipeline may contact. Hosts must be gov.in / nic.in (enforced in code). No national machine-readable scheme feed was found: myScheme exposes no documented public API and its pages are client-rendered, and several ministry sites (mohua, msde, pib, india.gov.in) return HTTP 403 to automated clients. Discovery therefore covers only the sources below; it is NOT exhaustive. www.punjab.gov.in was tried and excluded: its TLS server requires unsafe legacy renegotiation, which this project deliberately does not enable.

discovery.note: State portal sitemap listed in robots.txt

assistedSources.reason: Client-rendered (Next.js); no documented public API or terms for automated use. Text is imported from a rendering browser with provenance (npm run ingest -- import <file>).
Press Information Bureau returns HTTP 403 to non-browser clients; press releases are imported from a rendering browser with provenance.
